summary: Menu-option value display formatter. Seeds a 61-byte local format buffer with the first byte of byte_5EA438 then zeroes the rest, loads the option's selection type from this+0x32C and dispatches to VehicleSetupValueFormatter when it equals 4 or SetupValueFormatDispatcher otherwise, both writing into byte_7C56C0. Formats the option value string (this+0x320, text starting 30 bytes into the value block) into the local buffer with the "%s" format via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck, then returns StringCompareAndConditionalReplace(v4), which replaces the displayed string only when it changed.

local_names.this: menu option object holding the value pointer, selection type and formatter parameter
local_names.v2: selection type loaded from this+0x32C; decides vehicle-setup vs generic formatter path
local_names.v4: local 61-byte formatting buffer built by the call
local_names.v5: zeroed 16-bit tail of the local buffer
local_names.v6: zeroed byte tail of the local buffer

operations.description: Local buffer seeding: first byte copied from byte_5EA438 into v4[0], the remaining 60 bytes zeroed via memset, then the 16-bit v5 and byte v6 tail fields zeroed
Selection type loaded from this+0x32C into v2 to pick the formatter branch
Branch on selection type: vehicle-setup formatter path only when this+0x32C equals 4, otherwise generic dispatcher path
VehicleSetupValueFormatter invoked with byte_7C56C0 as the output target and the string-pointer field at this+0x324 as the value source when the selection type equals 4
SetupValueFormatDispatcher invoked with byte_7C56C0, the selection type loaded from this+0x32C, and the parameter field at this+0x328 for all non-4 selection types

StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck formats the option value string into the local buffer using the "%s" literal at 0x005C2C18; the source string is read 30 bytes past the pointer stored at this+0x320
Return value produced by StringCompareAndConditionalReplace on the formatted buffer, replacing the display only when the formatted value differs
Invoked by the indexed dispatch driver IndexedCallWith1Increment as the value-display step of a menu option

unresolved: Identity and role of byte_7C56C0 (session-name buffer versus file-loader flag in prior analysis) not established from this packet alone
Reason the first byte of byte_5EA438 is copied into the format buffer head is unclear; byte_5EA438 otherwise reads as a directory/path string
Why the option value string begins 30 bytes into the block pointed to by this+0x320 is not resolvable without the value-block layout
Semantics of the return value of StringCompareAndConditionalReplace (match indicator versus replace result) not confirmed
